encode_audio_to_codes: encode a mono audio waveform into discrete audio codes using HiggsAudioV2TokenizerModel.encode
decode_audio_codes_to_waveform: decode discrete audio codes back to a reconstructed audio waveform using HiggsAudioV2TokenizerModel.decode
encode_decode_audio_pipeline: run a full encode then decode pipeline on audio using HiggsAudioV2TokenizerModel.forward
extract_semantic_features: extract semantic features from an audio waveform using HiggsAudioV2TokenizerModel._extract_semantic_features
quantize_with_residual_vq: quantize audio embeddings into discrete indices using HiggsAudioV2TokenizerResidualVectorQuantization.encode
